summary: Analytics Academy is connecting data-wise students with non-profits.. Type: non-profit. About 4 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 3 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: A tiny Amsterdam non-profit linking econometrics students with NGOs that need data advice, which is a way to build consulting experience while doing social good.

culture.text: A 4-person non-profit in Amsterdam that gives econometrics students data-consultancy work for NGOs and social organisations.
Students also get trainings from leading consultancy firms as part of the programme.
People on LinkedIn come from schools including LMU Munich, University of Tübingen and Université Toulouse Capitole, mainly in data processing, business and marketing.

open.text: All 3 current openings here are open to people who don't speak Dutch.
It is not an IND recognised sponsor.

worth_knowing.text: Its LinkedIn postings draw about 130 applicants on average, so expect competition.
